question: What element is a greenish yellow gas with a characteristic smell at room temperature?
solution:
The correct answer is **Chlorine**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chlorine** is a greenish-yellow gas at room temperature.
 
• It has a characteristic pungent smell that is easily recognizable.
 
• Chlorine is commonly used in water purification and disinfectants.
 
• It is a highly reactive element and can form compounds with most other elements.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 Option 1: Chlorine
 Greenish-yellow gas, pungent smell, used in disinfectants.
 
 

 Option 2: Carbon monoxide
 Colorless, odorless gas, toxic and produced by burning fossil fuels.
 
 

 Option 3: Iodine
 Solid at room temperature, sublimates to a violet gas, used in antiseptics.
 
 

 Option 4: Hydrogen sulphide
 Colorless gas, smells like rotten eggs, highly toxic.
